A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Vision-DeepResearch and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-C. Pages 2-12 are textually and visually identical; the first-page changes do not limit comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations on six benchmarks in Table 1, pipeline and training-data ablations in Tables 2-3, and RL training curves in Figure 3.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, ablations, and RL training results in Tables 1-3 and Figure 3.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same multi-scale visual retrieval, text bridging, trajectory synthesis, SFT, and RL procedures. No method component, objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Training-data coverage is unchanged. Table 1 and Appendix B retain the same six evaluation benchmarks: VDR-Bench, FVQA, MMSearch-Plus, MMSearch, LiveVQA, and BrowseComp-VL.

E2.justification: Table 1 preserves every comparator within its corresponding evaluation setting, including the GPT-5, Gemini, Claude, Qwen, MMSearch-R1, and WebWatcher rows.

E3.justification: Section 2.3 and Appendix B retain identical model configurations, training budgets, benchmark splits, sample sizes, tool settings, and answer-assessment procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The pipeline and training-data ablations in Tables 2-3, RL training analysis in Figure 3, and case study in Appendix C and Figure 4 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the aggregate scores and RL curve reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All result entries, plotted findings, and qualitative outcomes are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains average scores of 50.5 for Vision-DeepResearch-8B and 56.9 for Vision-DeepResearch-30B-A3B.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and trajectory formulations in Equations 1-6 are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about multi-turn, multi-entity, multi-scale search, long-horizon reasoning, and performance relative to existing models and agent workflows.

C2.justification: Explanations of visual/textual retrieval complementarity, training benefits, and failure handling are unchanged. Section 3.4 retains the same limitation concerning API costs and wall-clock constraints on RL scaling.

D1.justification: Training-data counts, frameworks, precision, rollout limits, and evaluation details in Section 2.3 and Appendix B are identical. The abstract retains the same code-release promise and repository address.

R1.justification: The reference list and Appendix A's related-work discussion are identical. No cited work or substantive positioning relative to earlier research changes.

P1.justification: v2 adds Xu Tang to the author list, reflows that list from two lines to three, and updates the arXiv version and date. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block changes the first-page spacing, and Figure 1 is slightly reduced and repositioned. Its content and caption text are unchanged. All subsequent pages, figures, and tables render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 changes authorship information, version metadata, and first-page layout while retaining all scientific content, results, and appendices. These limited updates leave the paper's evidential support, reproducibility, and substantive clarity unchanged, with no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
